title: Built-in themes in Your library and the Marketplace

steps.headline: Your library's Themes tab now lists the six themes built into the app, beside the ones you downloaded.
steps.changed: Light, Dark, Midnight, Crème, YouCoded and YouCoded Night each get a card, labelled YouCoded as the maker. Starred ones sit under Favorite themes, the rest under Installed themes.
steps.measured: Themes count 3 → 9 on this test profile
steps.notice: A built-in theme you unstarred is no longer lost: find it here and star it again to put it back in Appearance.
steps.risk: Six more cards to scroll past before you reach the themes you downloaded.

steps.headline: The Marketplace's Themes tab lists the built-in themes too, after the ones you can download.
steps.changed: The six built-in themes come after the theme store's themes, already installed, so they have a star instead of an Install button.
steps.notice: Searching the Marketplace for “night” or “dark” now finds the built-in ones too.
steps.risk: Someone browsing for new themes sees six they already have at the end of the list.

steps.headline: A built-in theme's page offers only Apply theme and the star, with a line saying it's always there.
steps.changed: No Uninstall, like or share buttons: these themes ship inside the app, so there's nothing to remove and no store page to like or share. It reads “Built into YouCoded, so it's always here.”
steps.notice: Opening YouCoded Night from either screen lets you switch to it in one click.
steps.risk: Built-in themes can't be liked, so they never show a like count like store themes do.
